A Vision of Back-To-School

The new school year is coming up fast, and parents and students are getting ready to embark on new adventures and experiences. But this is also a reminder to parents that good eyesight is possibly the most important school supply your child may not have.

Glaucoma Testing & Treatment

Glaucoma is not a single disease. It is actually a group of eye diseases that cause damage to the optic nerve due to an increase in pressure inside the eye, which is called intraocular pressure. When detected in the early stages, glaucoma can often be controlled.

New Expert Care for the Fort Myers Community: Welcome Dr. Kristin Nelson

Riverside Family Eye Care is proud to welcome Dr. Kristin Nelson to our clinical team. As an experienced optometrist and IACMM certified specialist, Dr. Nelson brings advanced expertise in myopia management and pediatric eye care to our practice. Whether she is performing a children’s eye exam for an infant or managing complex ocular health for adults, her focus remains on providing personalized eye care tailored to the specific needs of each neighbor we serve.

Dr. Nelson’s approach is rooted in patient-centered optometry, ensuring every visit is as comfortable as it is comprehensive. Beyond her clinical skill, her dedication to community eye care and global outreach aligns perfectly with our mission to treat every patient like a member of our own family. We invite you to schedule an appointment with our new pediatric optometrist and experience the customized, expert vision care that helps our Fort Myers community thrive.

Cataract Co-Management in Fort Myers


At Riverside Family Eye Care, we work closely with trusted cataract surgeons in Fort Myers, FL, to guide you every step of the way through your cataract surgery journey. From the initial diagnosis and referral to your post-operative care, we ensure that you receive seamless, personalized attention for the clearest possible vision.

If you’re considering cataract surgery in Fort Myers, you can rely on our caring eye doctors to address your questions, offer ongoing support, and help you enjoy life with renewed clarity.

Eye Emergencies

If you experience loss of vision, double vision, swelling, infection or any eye emergency, contact us immediately for guidance. We’ll help you with the best treatment to prevent complications and promote long-lasting clear eyesight.

Please call our office at: 239-500-2020 for further instructions. If urgent, find the nearest emergency room.
